publish.alt.caption: Caption: {text}

publish.series.new: This project has no series yet. Saving creates it; readers see it once the first chapter is published.
publish.series.cover_hint: Choose or generate the cover from a chapter’s publish screen.
publish.series.field.title: Series title
publish.series.field.links_hint: Plain links to your own pages. They open outside MangaVeyra.
publish.series.field.schedule_hint: Shown on the series page. Up to 60 characters.

publish.error.release_note: Keep the release note to 60 characters.
publish.error.creators: List only project members, each with a role and a name of up to 60 characters.

publish.error.title: Enter a title of up to 120 characters.
publish.error.tags: Use up to 16 tags of up to 40 characters.
publish.error.lang_missing: Some bubbles have no text in this language yet. Letter them first.
publish.error.no_pages: This chapter has no pages to publish yet.
publish.error.schedule: Pick a date and time in the future, within a year.
publish.error.ai_label: The label can show more AI involvement than recorded, never less.
publish.error.slug: Use 3–60 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
publish.error.slug_taken: Another series already uses this address.
publish.error.links: Each link needs a label of up to 40 characters and an http or https address (at most 5).
publish.error.stale: Someone saved the series meanwhile. Reload and try again.
publish.error.review_again: This chapter or its series changed after you opened this page. Nothing was published: review the details below, then publish again.
publish.live.title: Chapter {number} is live
publish.notify.title: {series} · Chapter {number} is out
